question: Can the v0.10 executable motor mechanism transfer from a Crazyflie 2.1 Brushless to an independently collected brushed Crazyflie 2.1 dataset when the input side is mapped through an independently measured motor-voltage-to-RPM realization and only a 2-second target-hardware calibration is used to fit the safe fallback and output write operator?

architecture.mechanism: The four-coefficient cubic Chebyshev h from the frozen v0.10 result is immutable.
architecture.source_realization: psi_c uses independently published Crazyflie 2.1+ P250 vmotor-to-RPM coefficients; no outcome variable is used to fit or warp psi_c.
architecture.write_realization: W_c is fitted from exactly 200 target transitions and can be disabled to recover the independently fitted mechanism-free fallback exactly.
architecture.safe_nesting: The fallback is fitted first. Every nonlinear model is fitted only to its residual.

calibration.window_rule: The first 201 consecutive samples whose mean four-motor PWM is at least 7000; rule uses inputs only.

development_search.selection_metric: Geometric mean across flights of the geometric mean cumulative 1-to-50-step position, velocity, orientation and angular-velocity errors.
development_search.selection_order: Select the shared fallback alpha first, then select each residual model independently.

controls: supplied quadratic in anchored RPM coordinate

holdout_discipline.confirmatory_rule: The development executable contains no confirmatory URLs or file accesses beyond names recorded in this protocol. A separate immutable confirmatory executable will be committed only after development selection is recorded.
holdout_discipline.failure_rule: The first confirmatory execution is permanent. No gate, file, metric or selected hyperparameter may be changed after it begins.

claim_boundary.supported_if_confirmed: Cross-hardware few-shot transfer of a frozen executable mechanism after independently anchored source realization and small safe write binding.
claim_boundary.not_supported: A universal motor law, unique causal attribution from passive correlated controls, state-of-the-art benchmark performance, or a general AI breakthrough.
